project.description:
One-shot, idempotent migration of an existing WildFly-era environment to the gateway-era configuration: installs gateway/operations/query env files (harvesting the introspection token, picsure MySQL password and logging API key from wildfly/standalone.xml; minting the internal, application-token and obfuscation-salt secrets), appends PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=health to the existing service env files, reroutes httpd /picsure from WildFly to the gateway, then stops and removes the wildfly container and archives its config dir to wildfly.retired-<timestamp>.
RUNNING THIS JOB STARTS THE CUTOVER OUTAGE (WildFly stops; httpd points at a gateway that is not deployed yet). Order: 1) on the host, ./update-jenkins.sh 2) this job 3) PIC-SURE Database Migrations 4) PIC-SURE Pipeline 5) Stop/Start PIC-SURE (httpd must restart to pick up the vhosts edit) 6) PIC-SURE Health Check.
Idempotent: re-running is safe and is the recovery path after a partial failure. Rollback: mv wildfly.retired-<ts> back to wildfly, re-sed httpd (gateway:8080/ -> wildfly:8080/pic-sure-api-2/PICSURE/), restart httpd, redeploy the old images. Scope: dockerized all-in-one installs only (install-dependencies-docker.sh); not legacy-installer or BDC/GIC stacks.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: git_hash
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: pic-sure-all-in-one ref providing the env templates. NOTE: defaults to the long-lived rewrite branch during the gateway migration; change to main after the final merge.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # Migrate a WildFly-era $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR to the gateway-era layout. Idempotent: every # phase self-guards, so re-running after a partial failure is the recovery path. Secrets # are resolved and validated BEFORE anything is written; their values are never printed.
set -u
DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR="${DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR:-/usr/local/docker-config}" TEMPLATE_DIR="initial-configuration/config"
GATEWAY_ENV="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/gateway/gateway.env" OPERATIONS_ENV="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/operations/operations.env" QUERY_ENV="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/query/query.env" LOGGING_ENV="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/logging/logging.env"
GATEWAY_KEYS="TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN LOGGING_API_KEY PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" OPERATIONS_KEYS="SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN" QUERY_KEYS="QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN"
SUMMARY="" note() { echo "==> $1"; SUMMARY="${SUMMARY} - $1 "; } fail() { echo "ERROR: $1" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR" ] || fail "DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR '$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR' is not a directory" [ -f "$TEMPLATE_DIR/gateway/gateway.env" ] || fail "workspace has no env templates under $TEMPLATE_DIR (wrong git_hash?)"
# ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
is_placeholder() { printf '%s' "$1" | grep -qx '__[A-Z_]\{1,\}__'; }
# real_value FILE KEY: prints KEY's value when present, non-empty and not a placeholder. real_value() { local v v=$(sed -n "s/^$2=//p" "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) [ -n "$v" ] || return 1 is_placeholder "$v" && return 1 printf '%s\n' "$v" }
# complete_env FILE KEY...: file exists, no placeholder outside comments, all KEYs real. complete_env() { local f="$1"; shift [ -f "$f" ] || return 1 grep -q '^[^#]*__[A-Z_]\{1,\}__' "$f" && return 1 local k for k in "$@"; do real_value "$f" "$k" >/dev/null || return 1 done return 0 }
# shared_value KEY FILE...: the single real value of KEY across FILEs; fails on divergence. shared_value() { local key="$1"; shift local val="" f v for f in "$@"; do v=$(real_value "$f" "$key") || continue if [ -n "$val" ] && [ "$v" != "$val" ]; then fail "$key differs between existing env files; reconcile manually, then re-run" fi val="$v" done printf '%s\n' "$val" }
mint() { tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 43; } mint_hex() { tr -dc 'a-f0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 32; }
# Harvest source: the live wildfly dir, else the newest archived one (re-run support). SRC_XML="" if [ -f "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/wildfly/standalone.xml" ]; then SRC_XML="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/wildfly/standalone.xml" else SRC_XML=$(ls "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR"/wildfly.retired-*/standalone.xml 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1) fi
# xml_prop NAME: value of <simple name="java:global/NAME" value="..."/>. xml_prop() { [ -n "$SRC_XML" ] || return 0 sed -n "s/.*java:global\/$1\" value=\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$SRC_XML" | head -n 1 }
# The PicsureDS <password> specifically -- standalone.xml has other <password> elements. xml_mysql_pass() { [ -n "$SRC_XML" ] || return 0 awk '/pool-name="PicsureDS"/{f=1} f && /<password>/{gsub(/.*<password>|<\/password>.*/,""); print; exit}' "$SRC_XML" }
harvested() { # NAME VALUE -> echoes VALUE unless it is empty or a placeholder if [ -n "$2" ] && ! is_placeholder "$2"; then printf '%s\n' "$2"; fi }
# ---- phase 1: resolve secrets (read-only) -----------------------------------
echo "== Phase 1: resolve secrets"
# shellcheck disable=SC2086 if complete_env "$GATEWAY_ENV" $GATEWAY_KEYS \ && complete_env "$OPERATIONS_ENV" $OPERATIONS_KEYS \ && complete_env "$QUERY_ENV" $QUERY_KEYS; then NEED_ENV_INSTALL=false # Divergence still matters on an already-migrated tree: a forked shared secret breaks at a # distance (gateway->ops internal calls 401). Check and fail loudly, but resolve nothing. shared_value QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN "$GATEWAY_ENV" "$OPERATIONS_ENV" "$QUERY_ENV" >/dev/null || exit 2 shared_value PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN "$GATEWAY_ENV" "$OPERATIONS_ENV" "$QUERY_ENV" >/dev/null || exit 2 note "gateway/operations/query env files already complete; no secrets to resolve" else NEED_ENV_INSTALL=true
TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=$(real_value "$GATEWAY_ENV" TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN) \ && note "TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN: reused from existing gateway.env" if [ -z "${TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN:-}" ]; then [ -n "$SRC_XML" ] || fail "need to harvest secrets but found no wildfly/standalone.xml (live or archived)" TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN=$(harvested token_introspection_token "$(xml_prop token_introspection_token)") [ -n "$TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN" ] || fail "token_introspection_token in $SRC_XML is missing or an unsubstituted placeholder" note "TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN: harvested from standalone.xml" fi
PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD=$(real_value "$OPERATIONS_ENV" SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD) \ && note "picsure MySQL password: reused from existing operations.env" if [ -z "${PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then [ -n "$SRC_XML" ] || fail "need to harvest secrets but found no wildfly/standalone.xml (live or archived)" PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD=$(harvested mysql_password "$(xml_mysql_pass)") [ -n "$PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD" ] || fail "PicsureDS password in $SRC_XML is missing or an unsubstituted placeholder" note "picsure MySQL password: harvested from standalone.xml (PicsureDS datasource)" fi
LOGGING_API_KEY=$(real_value "$GATEWAY_ENV" LOGGING_API_KEY) \ && note "LOGGING_API_KEY: reused from existing gateway.env" if [ -z "${LOGGING_API_KEY:-}" ]; then LOGGING_API_KEY=$(real_value "$LOGGING_ENV" LOGGING_API_KEY) \ && note "LOGGING_API_KEY: reused from logging/logging.env" fi if [ -z "${LOGGING_API_KEY:-}" ]; then LOGGING_API_KEY=$(harvested logging_api_key "$(xml_prop logging_api_key)") [ -z "$LOGGING_API_KEY" ] || note "LOGGING_API_KEY: harvested from standalone.xml" fi if [ -z "${LOGGING_API_KEY:-}" ]; then LOGGING_API_KEY=$(mint) if [ -f "$LOGGING_ENV" ]; then if grep -q '^LOGGING_API_KEY=' "$LOGGING_ENV"; then sed -i "s|^LOGGING_API_KEY=.*|LOGGING_API_KEY=$LOGGING_API_KEY|" "$LOGGING_ENV" else echo "LOGGING_API_KEY=$LOGGING_API_KEY" >> "$LOGGING_ENV" fi note "LOGGING_API_KEY: minted (was never configured); wrote the same key to logging/logging.env" else note "LOGGING_API_KEY: minted (logging service not enabled on this environment)" fi fi
QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN=$(shared_value QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN "$GATEWAY_ENV" "$OPERATIONS_ENV" "$QUERY_ENV") || exit 2 if [ -n "$QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" ]; then note "QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN: reused from existing env files" else QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN=$(mint); note "QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN: minted" fi
PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN=$(shared_value PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN "$GATEWAY_ENV" "$OPERATIONS_ENV" "$QUERY_ENV") || exit 2 if [ -n "$PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN" ]; then note "PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN: reused from existing env files" else PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN=$(mint); note "PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN: minted" fi
AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT=$(real_value "$QUERY_ENV" AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT) \ && note "AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT: reused from existing query.env" if [ -z "${AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT:-}" ]; then AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT=$(mint_hex); note "AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT: minted" fi
for name in TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD LOGGING_API_KEY \ QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT; do v="${!name}" [ -n "$v" ] || fail "$name resolved to an empty value" is_placeholder "$v" && fail "$name resolved to an unsubstituted placeholder" # Values are single-line by construction (sed/awk line extraction); | and & would # corrupt the s|...|...| substitutions in phase 2. case "$v" in *'|'* | *'&'*) fail "$name contains a character unsafe for substitution (| or &)";; esac done fi
# ---- phase 2: install the three new env files --------------------------------
echo "== Phase 2: install gateway/operations/query env files"
install_env() { # SUBDIR FILE KEY... local sub="$1" file="$2"; shift 2 local dest="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/$sub/$file" if complete_env "$dest" "$@"; then note "$sub/$file: already complete, left untouched" return 0 fi mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/$sub" if [ -f "$dest" ]; then cp "$dest" "$dest.pre-migration-${BUILD_NUMBER:-manual}" note "$sub/$file: incomplete -> backed up (.pre-migration-${BUILD_NUMBER:-manual}) and regenerated from the template" else note "$sub/$file: created from the template" fi cp "$TEMPLATE_DIR/$sub/$file" "$dest" sed -i \ -e "s|__TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN__|$TOKEN_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN|g" \ -e "s|__LOGGING_API_KEY__|$LOGGING_API_KEY|g" \ -e "s|__PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN__|$PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN|g" \ -e "s|__QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN__|$QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN|g" \ -e "s|__PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD__|$PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD|g" \ -e "s|__AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT__|$AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT|g" \ "$dest" complete_env "$dest" "$@" || fail "$sub/$file is still incomplete after substitution" }
if [ "$NEED_ENV_INSTALL" = true ]; then # shellcheck disable=SC2086 install_env gateway gateway.env $GATEWAY_KEYS # shellcheck disable=SC2086 install_env operations operations.env $OPERATIONS_KEYS # shellcheck disable=SC2086 install_env query query.env $QUERY_KEYS fi
# ---- phase 3: edit existing services in place ---------------------------------
echo "== Phase 3: actuator exposure + httpd routing"
append_actuator() { # RELATIVE_PATH local f="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/$1" if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then note "$1: not present on this environment, skipped" return 0 fi if grep -q '^PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=' "$f"; then note "$1: PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE already set" return 0 fi { echo "" echo "# Added by 'Migrate PIC-SURE Configuration to Gateway': rewrite-era images ship actuator off" echo "# by default; deploy smoke checks and the gateway /system/status probe need shallow health." echo "PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=health" } >> "$f" note "$1: appended PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=health" }
for f in psama/psama.env hpds/hpds.env dictionary/dictionary.env visualization/visualization.env logging/logging.env; do append_actuator "$f" done
for conf in httpd-vhosts.conf httpd-vhosts-ssloffload.conf; do c="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/$conf" [ -f "$c" ] || continue if grep -q 'wildfly:8080' "$c"; then sed -i 's|http://wildfly:8080/pic-sure-api-2/PICSURE/|http://gateway:8080/|g' "$c" note "httpd/$conf: rerouted /picsure from WildFly to the gateway" else note "httpd/$conf: already routes to the gateway" fi done if grep -rq 'wildfly:8080' "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/httpd/" 2>/dev/null; then fail "unrecognized wildfly:8080 references remain under httpd/; migrate those files manually and re-run" fi
# ---- phase 4: retire WildFly ---------------------------------------------------
echo "== Phase 4: retire WildFly"
if docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx wildfly; then docker stop wildfly docker rm wildfly || fail "could not remove the wildfly container" note "wildfly container: stopped and removed" else note "wildfly container: not present" fi
if [ -d "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/wildfly" ]; then archive="$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/wildfly.retired-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" mv "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/wildfly" "$archive" || fail "could not archive the wildfly config dir" note "wildfly config dir: archived to $(basename "$archive") (rollback anchor -- holds the original standalone.xml)" else note "wildfly config dir: not present" fi
# ---- summary -------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "" echo "================ migration summary ================" printf '%s' "$SUMMARY" echo "===================================================" echo "Next: 'PIC-SURE Database Migrations' -> 'PIC-SURE Pipeline' -> restart httpd (Stop/Start PIC-SURE) -> 'PIC-SURE Health Check'." exit 0
